en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan b. Sayf b. ’Umayra from Abdillah b. Abi Ya’fur from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

One who recites Surah Ahqaaf every Friday eve or Friday, Allah would keep him away from the troubles in the worldly life, and on the Day of Judgment he would be safe from the painful screams, if Allah wills.
